name: BC Invoice Forge Tests - project ruleset
description: Test app of the BC Invoice Forge per-tenant extension. Never deployed to production, never submitted to AppSource.

rules.justification: Per-tenant extension ID range; AppSource ID range validation does not apply.
AppSource listing properties (privacy statement, EULA, help, logo) are not required for a test app of a per-tenant extension.
AppSource listing URL is not required for a test app of a per-tenant extension.
No Application Insights resource is configured for this open-source app; telemetry is up to the installing tenant.
The app does not use namespaces yet; moving every object into namespaces is a separate change.
